integrity.claim_is_single: ordinary three-cut integral homology and Alexander-dual wedge description of multi-factor Cartesian clique products
integrity.proof_basis: explicit face classification, elementary collapses, coordinate path homotopies and integral Alexander duality

scientific_limitations: Homotopy decomposition is proved for the Alexander dual, not for the cut complex itself.
Only ordinary three-cut complexes of Cartesian products of at least three complete graphs with a nonbinary factor are claimed new.
No integral equivariant representation, other cut parameter or complete priority certificate is asserted.
Finite mod-two checks corroborate but are not substituted for the integral all-parameter argument.
title: Integral three-cut homology of Cartesian products of complete graphs
